_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Biology Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 10, Topics 10.1-10.9. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for the other 2013 OBC subjects in this app. The syllabus's own front-matter Table of Contents lists 12 separate 'Units' for Grade 10 (Organisms and life processes; Animal and plant cells; Cells and water; Nutrients; Enzymes; Dentition in mammals; Nutrition in animals; The Soil; Photosynthesis; Saprophytic nutrition; Respiration; Gaseous exchange), but the actual instructional table body groups and orders this content differently under 9 Topics (10.1-10.9) — for example, body Topic 10.2 merges what the front matter calls 'Animal and plant cells' and 'Cells and water' into one topic, and 'The Soil' does not appear anywhere in the Grade 10 body table at all; it is taught instead as Topic 12.6 in Grade 12, per the body. This file follows the instructional table body throughout, since it is the actual outcome content, not the front-matter listing. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 10 is modeled as a single term here.
